scheme_name: Free/Subsidized Paddy & High-Yielding Seed Distribution Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Distributes high-yielding paddy, pulse, and oilseed varieties to tribal and small farmers prior to Kharif and Rabi seasons.
benefits: 100% subsidy for SC/ST small farmers and 50% subsidy for general farmers on certified seed kits.
eligibility: Farmers, especially ST/SC cultivators in Silvassa, Daman, and Diu
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agriculture Office / District Panchayat

scheme_name: Subsidized Chemical & Organic Fertilizer Distribution Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Ensures affordable supply of bio-fertilizers, bacterial culture, and soil conditioners for crop fields.
benefits: Subsidized rates for fertilizer bags and organic bacterial culture kits.
eligibility: Resident farmers in UT Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
application_mode: Offline via Department of Agriculture, Silvassa / Daman

state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Promotes high-yielding orchards like Chickoo, Mango, and Coconut with plant saplings, fencing, and drip irrigation grants.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on fruit saplings, soil preparation, and drip setup.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land in the UT
application_mode: Offline via Soil Conservation & Horticulture Department

scheme_name: Subsidized Power Tiller & Farm Equipment Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Subsidizes modern farm machinery such as small tractors, weeders, power tillers, and spray pumps.
benefits: 50% subsidy (up to ₹50,000 for mini equipment and ₹1,500,000 for tractors) for eligible farmers.
eligibility: Individual farmers and farmer groups in DNH and Daman & Diu
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agriculture Office, Moti Daman / Silvassa

state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Financial assistance to convert flood irrigation into drip/sprinkler systems for water conservation.
benefits: Up to 70% subsidy on installation of micro-irrigation pipelines and emitters.
eligibility: Farmers having assured irrigation borewells or farm ponds

scheme_name: Soil Health Card & Soil Conservation Works Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Carries out soil levelling, field bunding, soil testing, and distribution of micronutrients to prevent erosion.
benefits: Free soil testing and 50% subsidy on field bunding and soil reclamation inputs.
eligibility: Cultivators in rural areas of DNH, Daman, and Diu
application_mode: Offline via Soil Conservation Officer, Silvassa / Daman

state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Encourages cultivation of off-season vegetables and cut flowers under controlled polyhouse environments.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for polyhouse and shade-net construction.
eligibility: Individual farmers and horticulturists in the UT

state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Provides cash grants for constructing permanent vermicompost pits and procuring earthworm cultures.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 per vermicompost unit.
eligibility: Farmers adopting organic farming practices in the UT

state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Creates a unified digital registry (AgriStack) for seamless distribution of government crop subsidies, direct benefit transfers, and insurance claims.
benefits: Direct access to single-window subsidized seeds, fertilizers, and instant DBT relief.
eligibility: All landholding and tenant farmers in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
application_mode: Online / Offline via District e-Governance / Agriculture Stack Counters

state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Provides battery-operated knapsack sprayers and bio-pesticides at concessional rates to protect crops from pest outbreaks.
benefits: 50% subsidy on battery sprayers and eco-friendly bio-pesticide formulations.
eligibility: Active crop growers in DNH and Daman & Diu
